svg.title: Twelve monthly regional model field maps for2024
svg.desc: Twelve complete-calendar low-pass mean salinity maps with correctly rotated mean velocity arrows. Geographic contours locate the fixed offshore source patch. The orange line identifies the section. These are model fields, not the Norwegian Coastal Current occupied footprint or physical width. Data support, source-cell means and raw means are retained in the accompanying regional map document.
